evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Scope and behavior are reasonably bounded (search via fingerprinting) and can be estimated without detailed design.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Provides a clear recommendation/filtering source (user profile) that is specific enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Behavior (collaborative filtering-style recommendations) is bounded and estimatable.
